LESSON: BUDDHIST VIHAAR IN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Worship 4.1 Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism (8 lessons) • Paying homage • t
Topic 4.2: Buddhist Vihaar in Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Buddhist Vihaar in Africa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Buddhist Vihaar in Africa
2. Practise Buddhist Vihaar in Africa at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Buddhist Vihaar in Africa

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Buddhist Vihaar in Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Buddhist Vihaar in Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Buddhist Vihaar in Africa at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Buddhist Vihaar in Africa at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Buddhist Vihaar in Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Buddhist Vihaar in Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Buddhist Vihaar in Africa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Buddhist Vihaar in Africa in the examples.
2. Explain Buddhist Vihaar in Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Buddhist Vihaar in Africa.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Buddhist Vihaar in Africa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Buddhist Vihaar in Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Buddhist Vihaar in Africa
2. Practise Buddhist Vihaar in Africa at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Buddhist Vihaar in Africa

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
